Outperform Complete Traces for Verdict Prediction\\\" Target Venue : EMNLP 2026 via ARR (deadline 2026-05-25)\\n Review Date : 2026-05-21\\n Reviewers : R1 (方法/实验严谨性), R2 (新颖性/完整性/引用)\\n Cross-sharing : Complete (R1↔R2, all [ AGREE]/[ REBUT ] collected) Summary 本文对 verdict prediction（测试执行 pass/fail 分类）任务进行了系统性的 trace 组件消融实验，涵盖 4 个模型（1.5B–13B，3 个架构家族）和 7 种 trace 表征。核心发现：(1) exception_ only 在所有模型上达到 ≥99.33%，而 full_ trace 仅约 72–82%；(2) 提出了 gradient dilution (~ 24%) 与 information overload (~ 76%) 的近似分解；(3) 观察到跨模型的 two-tier 组件层级模式。论文在消融设计的系统性上有贡献，但在 novelty、核心 claim 的因果强度、以及实验混淆变量控制上存在显著问题。 Strengths S1. 系统性的消融设计 [R1+R2 共识] \\n 7 种 trace 条件 × 4 个模型 × 3 个架构家族的矩阵设计在 trace 表征研究中是首次。实验覆盖面远超前人工作（TracePile、NExT 等仅使用单一或少量 trace 格式）。 S2. 跨模型一致性强 [R1+R2 共识] \\n exception_ only ≥99.33% 的结论在 Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B/1.5B、CodeLlama-13B、DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 上全部成立，跨 3 个架构家族的一致性增强了结论的可信度。 S3. 丰富的辅助分析 [R1] \\n 格式标记消融（nomarker ablation）、训练动态曲线、校准分析（ECE  < 0.005）、trace 长度 budget sweep、DebugBench 跨数据集实验等构成了多维度的证据链。17 节 Appendix 提供了充分的补充材料。 S4. 论文写作整体清晰 [R2] \\n Section 2（Method）的任务定义和数据集描述准确完整。Table 1 的跨模型主实验表格信息传达直观有效。Related Work 覆盖面广（53 citations），涵盖 7 个相关方向。 S5. 校准结果有意义 [R1] \\n ECE  < 0.005 表明 compact 输入不仅提高准确率，还改善了模型置信度与实际正确率的对齐——这对下游应用（如 fault localization）有实际意义。 Weaknesses Must-Fix（共识项，需解决后方可接收） MF-1. 核心发现 near-tautological [R1-N1 + R2-N1, 双方 AGREE]  ⚠️\\n Exception events More\\\" 的 framing 夸大了发现的反直觉性——exception events 之所以有效并不令人惊讶，真正需要解释的是 full trace 为何严重损害性能。 建议 ：将论文核心叙事从 \\\"exception events are surprisingly effective\\\"（近乎同义反复）reframe 为 \\\"quantifying why complete traces actively harm SFT learning\\\"（非平凡且有价值的发现）。标题需相应调整。 MF-2. 24%/76% 分解存在严重混淆变量 [R1-N1 + R2 AGREE]  ⚠️\\n full_trace_label_only  相对于标准  full_trace  同时改变了三个变量：(a) 梯度来源分布，(b) 有效学习率，(c) 训练目标。这使得 \\\"24% gradient dilution / 76% information overload\\\" 的归因无法可靠成立。更严重的是，该分解在 CodeLlama 和 DeepSeek 上 collapse 至 ~ 28.5%（接近随机），仅在 Qwen 家族（2/4 模型，1/3 架构）上成立。Round 12 已将 C3 降级为 \\\"preliminary \section{Method}

\subsection{Task Definition and Information Density}

We study \emph{verdict prediction}: given a Python function, a test input, and an optional execution trace, predict whether the test passes or fails.
The model produces a single token (\texttt{pass} or \texttt{fail}), making this a binary classification task.
Unlike code generation \citep{chen2025tracepile} or output prediction \citep{gu2024cruxeval}, verdict prediction isolates the model's ability to detect faults from its ability to simulate execution, providing cleaner ablation contrasts than generation tasks.

We define \emph{information density} as the ratio of verdict-diagnostic tokens to total sequence length, operationalized as the accuracy improvement per input token across trace conditions.
\texttt{exception\_only} inputs (${\sim}$150 tokens, 99.83\%) exemplify high density; \texttt{full\_trace} inputs ($>$2{,}048 tokens, ${\sim}$81\%) exemplify low density despite containing strictly more diagnostic information.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate Figure 1 (pipeline overview) with fixed text overlap."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(14.1, 5.7))
ax.set_xlim(0, 14.1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 5.7)
ax.axis('off')

def add_box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, subtext=None, color='#E8E8E8', text_color='black',
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', badge=None, badge_color='white'):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                         facecolor=color, edgecolor='#888888', linewidth=1.2)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if subtext:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h*0.6, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight, color=text_color)
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h*0.28, subtext, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=8, color='#555555', style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h/2, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight, color=text_color)
    if badge:
        bx = x + w - 0.15
        by = y + h/2
        badge_box = FancyBboxPatch((bx - 0.45, by - 0.18), 0.9, 0.36,
                                    boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                                    facecolor=badge_color, edgecolor='#888888', linewidth=0.8)
        ax.add_patch(badge_box)
        ax.text(bx, by, badge, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

def add_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.5))

# Left pipeline boxes
bh = 1.0
mid_y = 2.35

add_box(ax, 0.3, mid_y, 1.8, bh, "Code + Test", subtext="HumanEval+\nMBPP+\nDebugBench",
        color='#D6E4F0')
add_arrow(ax, 2.1, mid_y + bh/2, 2.8, mid_y + bh/2)

add_box(ax, 2.8, mid_y, 1.6, bh, "Execute", subtext="Python tracer", color='#D6E4F0')
add_arrow(ax, 4.4, mid_y + bh/2, 5.1, mid_y + bh/2)

add_box(ax, 5.1, mid_y, 1.6, bh, "Raw Trace", subtext="calls, vars,\nexceptions,\nassertions\n(~2000 tok)",
        color='#E8E8E8')
add_arrow(ax, 6.7, mid_y + bh/2, 7.2, mid_y + bh/2)

# Dashed box: Trace Compression Strategies
dash_x, dash_y, dash_w, dash_h = 7.2, 0.5, 3.4, 4.7
dashed_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((dash_x, dash_y), dash_w, dash_h,
                                       boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
                                       facecolor='#FAFAFA', edgecolor='#AAAAAA',
                                       linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--')
ax.add_patch(dashed_rect)
# Title ABOVE the dashed box to avoid overlap
ax.text(dash_x + dash_w/2, dash_y + dash_h + 0.15, "Trace Compression Strategies",
        ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#555555')

# Condition boxes inside dashed region (from top to bottom)
cw, ch = 2.8, 0.75
cx = dash_x + (dash_w - cw) / 2
gap = 0.2

# No Trace (top) - gray
cy_no = dash_y + dash_h - ch - 0.35
add_box(ax, cx, cy_no, cw, ch, "No Trace", subtext="(code+test only)",
        color='#D5D5D5', fontsize=10)

# Full Trace - light orange
cy_full = cy_no - ch - gap
add_box(ax, cx, cy_full, cw, ch, "Full Trace", subtext="(up to 2048 tok)",
        color='#FFE0B2', fontsize=10, badge="81.44%", badge_color='#FFF3E0')

# VOTA - green/teal
cy_vota = cy_full - ch - gap
add_box(ax, cx, cy_vota, cw, ch, "VOTA", subtext="(decision-relevant)",
        color='#C8E6C9', fontsize=10, badge="99.41%", badge_color='#E8F5E9')

# Exception Only (bottom) - yellow, highlighted
cy_exc = cy_vota - ch - gap
add_box(ax, cx, cy_exc, cw, ch, "Exception Only", subtext="(error events)",
        color='#FFF9C4', fontsize=10, badge="99.83%", badge_color='#FFFDE7')
# Star marker
ax.text(cx - 0.15, cy_exc + ch/2, '★', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=14, color='#FFB300')

# Arrow from dashed box to SFT Training
add_arrow(ax, dash_x + dash_w, mid_y + bh/2, 11.0, mid_y + bh/2)

# SFT Training box
add_box(ax, 11.0, mid_y, 1.6, bh, "SFT Training",
        subtext="LoRA fine-tuning\nQwen-2.5-Coder-7B\nDS-Coder-6.7B",
        color='#B3E5FC')
add_arrow(ax, 12.6, mid_y + bh/2, 13.0, mid_y + bh/2)

# Verdict box
add_box(ax, 13.0, mid_y - 0.1, 0.9, bh + 0.2, "Verdict", subtext="pass / fail",
        color='#E0E0E0', fontsize=10)

# Save
out_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
paper_dir = os.path.join(out_dir, 'paper')
os.makedirs(paper_dir, exist_ok=True)

pdf_path = os.path.join(paper_dir, 'fig1_trace_overview.pdf')
png_path = os.path.join(paper_dir, 'fig1_trace_overview.png')
fig.savefig(pdf_path, format='pdf')
fig.savefig(png_path, format='png')
plt.close()
print(f"Saved: {pdf_path}")
print(f"Saved: {png_path}")
